FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Event Def Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates the def for Empire events to provide greater control over event availability.

patchNoteLines.li: Can restrict events based on tech level, cooldown, faction age, required policy

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Event updates
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Update some events to use the new FCEventDef fields.

patchNoteLines.li: Drug Trade has a 30-day cooldown, and can only fire after the Empire faction is 5 days old
Independence Petitions has a 10-day cooldown, can only fire after the Empire faction is 5 days old, and requires at least 3 settlements in the faction
Moonlit Ritual has a 30-day cooldown, and can only fire after the Empire faction is 5 days old
Settling Down has a 15-day cooldown, and requires at least 2 settlements in the faction
Strange Discovery has a 30-day cooldown, and can only fire after the Empire faction is 5 days old
Wanderlust has a 15-day cooldown

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Variable-length Events
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Add the ability to set a variable duration for Empire Events.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds timeTillTriggerMax field to FCEventDef. If set, and larger than timeTillTriger, then the event's duration will be randomly chosen from the range (timeTillTrigger, timeTillTriggerMax)

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Edict UI Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Small change to the edicts UI to hopefully make things more clear.

patchNoteLines.li: If an edict is currently being enacted (and thus isn't yet applying its bonuses), its bonus text in the menu is grayed out

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Manual Battle Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds some extra pawn-cleanup after manual battles.

patchNoteLines.li: After a manual battle, all non-player pawns that were drafted are moved back to the Empire faction

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Linux Patch Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Attempts to fix an issue with the existing Linux patch.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: existing linux patch hadn't been updated for the new refactored code patterns

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor UI fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Couple of quick fixes for UI issues.

patchNoteLines.li: Building window filter buttons: truncate button label if it's too long
Event window: add scrollview for events with many options

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fix a couple of issues exposed by the test suite.

patchNoteLines.li: Fix the building count test to call the correct function after changing how bulding counts work
Fix titheValueMultiplier to actually apply to settlements
Instead of baking modifier readouts into event descriptions, they are dynamically generated

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: More tests
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A handful of changes to the test suite.

patchNoteLines.li: Updates a couple existing tests and adds a few new ones
Adds a tooltip to the Tax Base section of the settlement window UI, breaking down contributions to the tax base

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Orbital Building Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes stat modifiers on a couple of orbital buildings.

patchNoteLines.li: Space Distillery and Orbital Trade Hub's taxBasePercentage modifiers were too low

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor bill fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Handful of small fixes for bills.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds null guards and checks to a handful of bill code paths

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor extensibility fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A couple small changes to extensibility for resource modifiers.

patchNoteLines.li: Split IResourceProductionModifier.GetResourceModifierDesc into GetResourceAdditiveDesc and GetResourceMultiplierDesc

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Event Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Let Events specify a maximum number of times they can fire in a playthrough.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds a maxFireCount field to FCEventDef, specifying the maximum number of times the event can fire (default is -1, for unlimited)

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Patch notes backend change
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Some backend changes to patch notes to take less space.

patchNoteLines.li: Removes redundant fields from the PatchNoteDef and sets up a parent with common info. Significant reduction in lines of xml dedicated to patch notes
